entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to an available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
I'm certainly sorry to hear that. To make sure I understand correctly, could you tell me what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a preference?
It's a technical fault. The whole thing is not working correctly. The pulse tracker is inaccurate and now it won't sync with the app at all. It's defective.
Okay, I understand. It's definitely frustrating when a device isn't performing as it should. I can help you with that. Can I get your full name and order number to pull up your details?
Mark Peterson. Order number is VF88675.
Thank you, Mark. One moment while I access your account... Okay, I see your order for the VeloBand GPS Tracker, delivered on December 15th. That was about 40 days ago.
Alright, let me just review our policy for a defective item... Okay, yes. I see here that our policy allows for returns within 10 days of delivery. You're unfortunately outside that window.
Oh. I was expecting a fight. So you'll take it back?

Yes, absolutely. Since the item is defective and it's within the 10-day timeframe, I can process a return for a full refund for you right now. I'm generating a prepaid shipping label to send to your email on file.

Of course. The email has just been sent. Please package the VeloBand in its original box, attach the label, and drop it off at any post office. Once we receive the unit, your refund will be issued. Is there anything else I can assist with?
Alright. Well, thank you for calling VeloFit, and my apologies again for the trouble with your device. Have a good rest of your day.
